newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NRG/CMS group win Loy Yang A with A$4.86 bln bid.
newsitem.headline: NRG/CMS group win Loy Yang A with A$4.86 bln bid.

text.p: A consortium led by U.S. utilities NRG Energy Inc and CMS Energy Corp have won the bidding for Australia's state owned Loy Yang A power station, Victorian Premier Jeff Kennett said on Tuesday.

The consortium, which also includes Macquarie Bank Ltd's Infrastructure Trust, bid A$4.746 billion and assumed A$109 million of liabilities from the government for the 2,000 megawatt power station and associated brown coal mine.
CMS said its independent power subsidiary, CMS Generation, would hold a 50 percent ownership interest.
NRG Energy and Horizon Energy Australia Investments would each hold a 25 percent ownership interest in the acquired assets.
Horizon Energy Australia Investments is an institutional investment group including Macquarie Bank, ANZ Investment Bank, Infrastructure Trust of Australia and UniSuper.
The companies expected to close the transaction and assume ownership and operating responsibility within one month's time, CMS said.
